coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Edgewater
record.summary: A six-story, 193-unit apartment building at 355 Berry Street in Mission Bay North (Assessor block 8707 lot 003, class Apartment 15 Units or more, Assessor roll year built 2007; the building permit shows completed 2008-02-14 and describes 5 stories and 194 units; see open questions). Its footprint is on the north bank of Mission Creek on the OCII land use map and OSM.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is Assessor lot 8707003 (7,436 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the surveyed building footprint (OpenStreetMap (way 46264111, 355 Berry St)); 96% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 79% of the lot.

changes.text: The record had no address. The Assessor's active lot 8707003 lists the address 355 Berry St. Added as the record's address.

The 2005 building permit describes 5 stories and 194 dwelling units; the Assessor roll gives 6 stories and 193 units. No source read explains the differences. The $32.6 million figure is a permit valuation with no date of its own, not a verified construction cost.
Edgewater's completion now shows the building permit's completed date of February 14, 2008. The Assessor's 2007 'year built' is a roll year, not a completion event; both are recorded.

open_questions: Developer and architect not confirmed by any source found as of 2026-09-29, consistent with the notes on this record's map shape.
Precise opening month not available; DataSF's Assessor tax roll gives only a year.

A listing site's '6 units' figure (noted on this record's map shape) reads as a floorplan-type count, not the building's 193-unit total per the Assessor tax roll -- flagged there rather than reconciled here.

The 2005 construction permit's own unit count (194) is one more than the Assessor's 193, and the permit says 5 stories where the Assessor roll says 6; no source read explains either difference, and they are not reconciled here.

Completion date: the Assessor roll gives 2007 as year built (a roll year, not a completion event), while the building's permit #200502085025 shows a completed date of 2008-02-14 (DataSF i98e-djp9). The roll's current-sale date for the parcel is 2008-03-28. No source gives a certificate-of-occupancy date.

record.notes: Assessor roll (parcel 8707003) gives year built 2007 and 193 units, and the 2005 DBI permit gives 194 units; SocketSite (August 20, 2007) gave 198 units when leasing began. The year built is the Assessor roll's value, not a completion event: the same DBI permit (200502085025) shows a completed date of 2008-02-14, and SocketSite reported renters already moving in in August 2007. These dates and counts are not reconciled, and no source gives a certificate-of-occupancy date. Developer not confirmed by any source found.
